name: @papercupai/design-phase
description: MCP + HTTP tools for the design-phase agent loop. Designer agents use these to validate IR specs, lint anti-patterns, persist accepted specs to PG, browse design memos, and resolve the per-harness DESIGN_SPEC.md fallback chain. Plan: apps/operator/content/internal-docs/design/design-phase-plan.mdx.
author: Papercusp

tools.name: validate_spec
tools.description: Schema-validate a UI IR document against the v0.1 JSON Schema. Returns structured errors. Use this before submit_spec to fail fast on shape problems.

tools.name: lint_spec
tools.description: Run anti-pattern lint rules over a UI IR document. Errors block acceptance; warnings flow to the design-crit prompt. Use this alongside validate_spec before submit_spec.

tools.name: submit_spec
tools.description: Validate + lint + persist a UI IR spec to PG. Writes a row to harness_shared.harness_design_artifacts (kind='spec') and updates harness_features_consolidated.design_status. Refuses if validation or lint errors exist (warnings are OK).

metadata.description: Cost/token telemetry; passes through to the artifact row.

tools.name: list_memos
tools.description: List design memos at apps/operator/content/internal-docs/design/*.mdx with their slug, title, and (when frontmatter declares one) status.

tools.name: read_memo
tools.description: Read a single design memo's full markdown body by slug.

tools.name: get_design_spec
tools.description: Resolve the active DESIGN_SPEC.md via the harness → workspace → app-default → empty fallback chain. Returns the layer it came from, the source path, the body markdown, and parsed frontmatter.

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search the active ecosystem's component registry. Returns matching primitives with id, summary, inputs, variants. Designer agents call this first to pick from existing components instead of inventing new ones. v0.1 ships a hand-curated set for react-tailwind.

tools.name: get_registry_component
tools.description: Get a single registry component's full entry by id (e.g. 'action.primary'). Returns the per-ecosystem source pointer, importHint, propMap, variants, states, examples — everything the implementer agent needs to consume the component.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List DTCG tokens from the workspace token store (design/tokens/base.json). Returns flattened entries with id, type, value, description, group. Optional category filter (e.g. 'color', 'space', 'duration'). Designer agents call this to learn what tokens exist before composing IR; lint catches references to unknown tokens.

category.description: Filter by id prefix (e.g. 'color') or DTCG type (e.g. 'dimension').

tools.name: read_token
tools.description: Read a single DTCG token by id (e.g. 'color.bg.surface'). Returns its type, value, description, and group.

tools.name: get_accepted_spec
tools.description: Fetch the accepted UI IR spec for a feature, resolved via design_spec_id. Returns the IR JSON, metadata (cost telemetry), and creation timestamp. Reviewer agents call this at the start of a post-ship review pass.

tools.name: record_review
tools.description: Record a reviewer verdict on a feature's accepted spec. Verdicts: 'approved' (keeps design_status=accepted, terminal), 'rejected' (flips design_status back to pending so the orchestrator re-spawns a designer), 'changes-requested' (same flip, with notes for the next designer). Plan §4.2.

specId.description: Optional: the spec id this review applies to (recorded for audit).
